about: Curated questions for the public Ask tab (XX-08), answered over the fixture marts (tests/evals/fixture_marts.sql), never real listening data. Drafted by Claude for Evan to edit; scripts/refresh_ask_cache.py turns them into ask/public_cache.json with the live model.
questions: Who are my top 3 artists by plays?
What hour of the week do I listen most?
Which artist have I played the most days in a row?
How many minutes did I listen each day?
How long was my longest listening session, and when did it start?
Which tracks have I played more than once?
